verdict.rationale: mParticle's own docs include a page titled "Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle", and its Data Privacy Controls describe forwarding rules that filter events before they reach downstream destinations. This points to some first-party in-pipeline transformation and filtering, but the evidence is a bare doc title plus a consent-specific filtering example, with no detail on how transformations work. Missing for 10: evidence of custom code or functions, documented enrichment capability, depth of the transformation docs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
